name: Runtipi 4.12 sign-in key
author: wizard
description: The App Manager and the shell's server tools talk to Runtipi with Runtipi 4.12's private sign-in key instead of the older shared secret in runtipi/.env. Nothing looks different: app installs, updates, the app list and server readings keep working. On a server older than 4.12 they keep using the old secret.
